messages:
Ava (Marketing): quick thread to lock the micro-run blocks for next week's webinar. want to add a 3m live poll after the demo and confirm inbound lead routing to Intercom + nurture flow. thoughts?
Riley (Prod Marketing): love the poll idea. suggest question: "Which infra win matters most to you?" options: latency, cost, reliability, rollout. will wire poll slide and follow-up CTA.
Zo (Growth): for lead routing: tag responses in Intercom, then push those with 'cost' > 50% interest into a 3-email nurture focused on quantization & savings. can we capture UTM+poll answer in the lead object?
Sam (Events Ops): we can capture poll metadata in the RSVP payload and send to Intercom via webhook. need final poll schema by Thurs so engineering can wire it.
Diego (Eng): i'll add a tiny endpoint to accept poll webhooks and add tags. also prototyping a lightweight eval that validates we don't get >1k reqs/s spike during live polls.
Nico (Video): adding poll as a lower-third overlay; need slide anchor and timestamp in run-of-show. presenters should call out the poll verbally. i'll run a visual check in dry-run.
Riley (Prod Marketing): speaker flow tweak: 1) Priya intro + thesis (8m) 2) Marco demo (20m) 3) mini-benchmark narrative (6m) 4) poll + customer (6m) 5) q&a (15m). micro-benchmark narrative will surface cost/latency tradeoffs across 3 profiles.
Ava (Marketing): good. make sure benchmark narrative is high-level and actionable for PM/eng audiences — avoid model-architecture deep dives. include 2 quick one-line takeaways per profile.
Diego (Eng): for the benchmark slides i'll export 3 reproducible run commands and one-small YAML snippet showing batching/quant settings. will keep them as appendices not main slides.
Zo (Growth): after webinar: auto-tag attendees by poll answer, then route hot leads (attended + poll interest high + asked a question) to SDR queue within 30m. medium leads -> nurture. will document thresholds.
Sam (Events Ops): run-of-show draft updated with poll:
- 00:00 join + housekeeping (Ava)
- 02:00 thesis + context (Priya)
- 10:00 demo (Marco)
- 30:00 micro-bench narrative (Riley)
- 36:00 live poll (all)
- 39:00 customer vignette (Lila)
- 45:00 live q&a (panel)
- 60:00 wrap
Sam (Events Ops): dry-run Mon 10am PT. speakers upload final slides by Sun 11:59pm PT.
Ava (Marketing): OpsBot, please schedule poll-webhook dry-run reminder for Fri 9am to @Diego @Zo @Sam.
OpsBot: Reminder scheduled: poll-webhook-dryrun -> Fri 09:00 PT to @Diego @Zo @Sam
Nico (Video): presenters join greenroom 20m early. i'll test the lower-third poll overlay during dry-run.
Riley (Prod Marketing): i'll draft the 3-email nurture and the poll-to-CTA copy, drop in doc by Fri noon.
Ava (Marketing): nice work team. last item: can someone draft a 30s highlight clip plan (timecodes + visuals) so Sam/Nico can capture during live?
Sam (Events Ops): i'll owner highlights. Diego, can you flag the 30s clip points in demo so we have clean transitions?
Diego (Eng): yep i'll mark 2 timestamps in the demo script and leave room for a 10s caption overlay.
Ava (Marketing): thanks all 389 will post final run 24h before event.
